items.title: How 'brave & balanced' Brighton beat Man City
items.description: Match of the Day pundits Danny Murphy and Stephan Warnock analyse Brighton's impressive 1-0 victory over Manchester City, with Warnock praising the balance of the Seagulls squad.

items.title: Has Martinez become a liability for Man Utd?
items.description: Match of the Day pundits Danny Murphy and Stephan Warnock analyse Lisandro Martinez's performance in Manchester United's 2-0 defeat to Chelsea, where the Argentinian defender was sent off.

items.title: Are Manchester United really at risk of a relegation scrap?
items.description: Manchester United's current tally of nine points from seven games would not even get them 30 points if it was continued for the full season.

items.title: Coventry, Ipswich, Hull - promoted trio enjoy positive starts
items.description: The three teams have collected a respectable 31 points in total after nine games, and all currently sit above the relegation zone.

items.title: Kane misses Bayern penalty before late Dortmund goal earns draw
items.description: Harry Kane misses from the spot as Bayern Muich are held to a 2-2 draw with Borussia Dortmund in Der Klassiker after Fabio Silva's late equaliser.

items.title: Aston Villa latest: Emery admits work to do ahead of Barcelona and Man Utd
Fulham latest: We can beat anyone, says Arbeloa
McInnes demands more after delivering Rangers' trophy chance
items.description: Derek McInnes knows there is room for improvement as he steers in-form Rangers to the Premier Sports Cup final with a 1-0 win over Aberdeen.

items.title: Chelsea beat 10-man Man Utd to pile more pressure on Carrick
items.description: Lisandro Martinez is sent off for Manchester United as they suffer a 2-0 defeat against Chelsea at Stamford Bridge to pile more pressure on under-fire manager Michael Carrick.

items.title: Brighton pick up first away league victory over Man City
items.description: Brighton pick up their first away league victory at Manchester City, winning 1-0 to condemn City to a second successive Premier League defeat.

items.title: Coventry out of bottom three after win over struggling Sunderland
items.description: Frank Lampard's Coventry City lift themselves out of the relegation zone after beating struggling Sunderland, who remain rooted to the bottom of the Premier League table.

items.title: Enciso's stunning goal earns Ipswich draw at Hull
items.description: Julio Enciso scores the equalising goal for Ipswich as they draw 2-2 with Hull at the MKM Stadium.
